messages:
Elaine: Hey team — hit a weird soft-decline on my Redwood corporate card at the hotel front desk this morning. Card terminal said 'call issuer' but the hold never completed. last4: 4321. I'm checking with the hotel now but wanted to know policy: should I use personal card and submit an expense, or wait for CardOps? :thinking:
Samir (Finance): Sorry to hear that. Short answer: use personal card + submit an expense with receipt if you need to check in. We'll reimburse ASAP. Please include a brief note about the decline and the hotel name.
Elaine: thanks. I took a photo of the declined terminal screen and the card terminal slip — attaching: https://drive.redwood/receipts/1829991112-hotel-decline.jpg
Samir (Finance): Got it. Two follow-ups: 1) please add the photo and the hotel folio when you file the expense. 2) we'll escalate to CardOps to check for any temporary merchant block or velocity rule on 4321.
CardOps Bot: New ticket created: CO-2026-487. CardOps will review velocity and merchant MCC flags. ETA 4 hours.
Elaine: Appreciate it — I'm at front desk now, they said they can hold the room with a different card. Using my personal to avoid delay. Filing expense after checkout.
Samir (Finance): That's fine. Quick tip when you submit: use expense category "Travel - Hotel" and in the description mention "card decline - corp card 4321". If the amount is >$750, ping me for an expedited review.
Morgan (People Ops): Hi Elaine — if this turns into an overnight reimbursement need (hotel deposit), we can advance a one-time travel advance. LMK if you need that and I can start it.
Elaine: Not necessary today, personal card covers it. Filing expense now. Thanks! :thumbsup:
Samir (Finance): Filed expense noted. Once CardOps confirms, we'll either clear the block or issue a one-time lift if it's merchant-specific. Will update thread when ticket CO-2026-487 is resolved.
CardOps Bot: Update CO-2026-487: found merchant MCC flagged for suspected AVS mismatch — cleared and lifted limit for next 2 hours. Please retry corp card if you still need to charge.
Elaine: Tried again at checkout and it worked, hotel charged corp last4: 4321 for $312.45. I voided my personal charge, attached refund screenshot: https://drive.redwood/receipts/1829991112-refund.jpg
Samir (Finance): Perfect — thanks for the follow-up and receipts. We'll match the hotel folio and close the ticket. If you see any residual holds show up, DM CardOps directly.
Elaine: Great, closing on my side. :relieved:
